title: The Work page says how long an item takes from release to merge, and warns when the pipeline stalls
description: The real control plane's /api/status reads release-to-merge time over the last 10 merges, the last merge and the open item released longest ago from the ledger. A real browser on the built dashboard at 390 and 1280 px shows one calm sentence with the median, the slowest tenth and the time since the last merge, with no ids; when the last merge is over three times the median old, or an item has run past the slowest tenth, the sentence becomes a warning naming that item's key, title and stage with one next action. No page scrolls sideways and the top bar's counts keep their meaning.

steps.name: status serves release-to-merge minutes, last merge and the oldest open item from the ledger
